name: water
title: Water and marine media profile
description: Environmental media documenting water quality, hydrology, and marine or freshwater habitat condition. Observations use observationType waterQuality, habitatCondition, or pollution. Quantitative parameters belong in measurements.
notes: Benthic organisms observed as species belong in Camtrap DP, Darwin Core, or an OBIS/DwC-A export.
CoralNet and similar model outputs are measurements (imageDerived or modelOutput).
